==Airlines and destinations==

During its peak [[Tourism|tourist]] season, between November and March, Cape Town International maintains direct flights to 30 destinations across 35 routes, facilitated by 24 airlines and 228 flights per week.

*<small>{{note|c|c}} Lusaka flights operate via Livingstone on the same flight number.</small>
* <small>{{note|d|d}} This flight operates via Johannesburg. However, this carrier does not have rights to transport passengers solely between Cape Town and Johannesburg.</small>
